object.description: Setup: paired strap, session recording. Steps: 1. Observe the Active screen while the strap is searched for, connected, out of range, and in each failure case of PACE-STS-73, and with Bluetooth off at Start. Expected: A status text is shown for searching, signal lost, plugin missing, no ANT+ adapter and Bluetooth unavailable, each different from the others; no status text is shown while connected.
